maya: quick flag  promoted v5-int4 to 3% earlier — long-docs slice shows F1 drop -0.018 and halluc_rate +0.016. odd given latency/cost are fine. :grimacing:
deploy-bot: promotion: model=rwd-v5 variant=v5-int4 traffic=3% at 1719456000 by orchestrator.
liam: do we have shadow coverage for long-docs? any sample diffs?
maya: shadow was sparse for that slice. pulled 3k live examples; KV cache hit rate for that slice fell 0.92 -> 0.74 post-promote.
jorge: low cache hit + int4 path = suspicious. could be KV layout/eviction change in the quant runtime. capture decoder traces + logits for worst cases.
srijan: also verify decoding param parity (temp/top_p/stop) and recent tokenizer patch around 1719400000.
maya: lowering traffic to 0.5% while we debug and running replay job rwd-replay-171945 to compare int8/int4/int32 outputs.
deploy-bot: traffic update: variant=v5-int4 -> 0.5% at 1719456300 by maya.
liam: run int8 shadow on same pool; if int8 matches baseline and int4 diverges, we should add mixed-precision fallback and require another shadow pass before re-promote.
maya: agreed. uploading logs + sample diffs to eval bucket. will report replay deltas and top-k token shifts in ~25-35m. :thumbsup:
